speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Wycombe. You have walked every mile of it. I offered you the spare at the foot of that hill, and you refused me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The back is better going than sitting. I said so at the foot. By the top it was true.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: In March you rode the other way, like a man who had been paid. Today you walked like a man who means to be.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not counting a pay. I am counting the hill, and the hill is behind me.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Wheatley, then Tetsworth for the bait, then the climb. I know every house between your river and this one by what it owes, and by who would sell.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Say them, then. You will say them whether I ask or not.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: A farm this side of Wheatley, mortgaged to a man in Oxford who has never seen the barn. An inn that changes hands at Michaelmas. The sign will be new before the beer is.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And the third. You keep a third until the mile goes dull.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: A widow at Wheatley. She will not take forty pound. The house is sound, the price is an insult, and she has told three of us so.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Forty pound.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: For hers. Not for a house you have not named. I price what is offered. I do not price a silence.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was going to ask you a house. I am not going to ask you that house.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Then ask me a thing I can answer in a mile, or hold your tongue and save it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: What is the price of oats at Wycombe?

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Higher than Shipston, and Shipston was already a penny the peck over last month. I asked three sellers. The first laughed. The second sent me to the third. The third will sell to a carrier he knows, and not give a figure to a stranger who wants one in his head.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: So there is no figure I may keep.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: There is a figure, and it is not yours. Hay is no kinder here than it was on Monday. You asked the price. The answer is a mile of being told you may not carry it off. You are not buying. I am not quoting.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I have asked, and I have not learned a sum, and the house is still unasked.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Oats. Not a widow, and not a chapel. That is the whole of the answer I will let you keep.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The house is in Stratford. It is not the widow's. I do not know whose it is. That is the whole of what I will say on a road.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Then keep it. Forty pound is her no, not your sum. If you put her no on a chapel, you will have invented a price, and I will not help you invent it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not put it there.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: You asked a carrier's question so you would not ask a buyer's. I have walked beside that trick before. The oats have no figure you may keep. The house you did not ask is still yours to not ask.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Beaconsfield by the last light. I know the shape of the rest. I do not know the bed.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Bread and bacon, and you will look at the purse before you sit. I am not your coffer. If it is eleven pence, it is eleven. If it is more, you will hear it before you are down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will look. I will not tell you the look. The back agreed with the walking. I am not taking the spare back on the flat, where refusing is easy.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Then keep my pace for the last of it. You refused the horse. Do not spend the refusal on a speech. Walk.
